name: Lessons in Love & Hate
overview: When an unpopular nerd (PEYTON MOORE) is assigned to tutor her school's wealthy new bad boy (CHASE WESCOTT), it’s hate-at-first-sight. But unexpected sexual tension blooms despite their enormous social differences. As Peyton gets a glimpse into Chase's privileged-but-soulless world, she finds an opportunity to finally let loose. Chase, meanwhile, finds himself wanting to prove to Peyton he’s more than just a spoiled rich kid.
